'''(Hey You) Free Up Your Mind''' is one of the ending themes for the English [[dub]] of ''[[M01|Mewtwo Strikes Back]]''. It is available on the film's [[Pokémon the First Movie (soundtrack)|soundtrack]] and is performed by {{wp|Emma Bunton}} (credited as "Emma Bunton a/k/a Baby Spice").
